ban.label: Account Ban
ban.title: Ban in Magic Rampage: Signs, Reasons and How to Unban an Account
ban.description: The main signs of a Magic Rampage account ban, possible reasons for a ban, and how to contact support.

paragraphs: Sometimes a player may notice that some online features in Magic Rampage have stopped working. This may be related to an account ban.
Below, we will look at the main signs of a ban, the reasons why an account can be banned, and what to do if your account was blocked by mistake.

sections.subtitle: Tavern
paragraphs: One of the signs of a ban is being unable to enter the Tavern. When you try to enter, you are disconnected from the server, and a message appears at the top of the screen:
sections.quote: “Unusual activity has been detected on your account. Some online multiplayer features may not work as expected.”

sections.subtitle: Weekly Dungeon
paragraphs: When an account is banned, the following restrictions may appear:
list: The Weekly Dungeon reward is always +1 token
You cannot increase the Weekly Dungeon difficulty above “Easy”

sections.subtitle: Competitive Mode
paragraphs: The following signs may also be noticeable in Competitive Mode:
sections.quote: “Suspicious activity has been detected on your account. Some Competitive Mode features will not work.”

list: You cannot play friendly matches with friends
You disappear from the player rankings in the Hall of Champions

sections.title: What Can You Get Banned For?
paragraphs: An account may be banned for interfering with the game or using third-party programs. In particular:
list: Changing numerical values using third-party programs — for example, modifying the amount of in-game currency or damage, or reducing prices

paragraphs: If a player actually performed such actions, the account will not be unbanned for these violations. In this case, there is no point in contacting support to ask them to remove the ban.

sections.title: How to Unban an Account?
paragraphs: If you have not performed any actions that can result in a ban but have noticed the signs listed above, contact the game's support team.
In your request, explain that your account was banned by mistake and be sure to provide:
It is recommended to contact support in English.
More information about how and where to properly contact game support can be found in the separate article: Go to article

sections.title: Important
sections.highlight: If you actually used third-party programs, modified game files or changed numerical values in the game, you should not contact support hoping to have the ban removed — accounts are not unbanned for these violations.
